Client portal delivery

One-time sync for leads added before the client portal was introduced

New and edited client leads sync automatically. Run this once after publishing the matching Firestore rules so existing assigned leads appear in their clients' portals. Unassigned leads are not shared.

!

Deletion requests

Only an admin can delete a lead. Everyone else asks here.

Backup

A complete copy of every collection, in a file you hold

Everything — leads, call recordings, the full activity trail, clients, people, invites, export history and deletion requests — read straight from Firestore and written to one file. The JSON is the one to keep: it restores. The Excel copy is for reading.

This is a manual copy, and it is only as fresh as the day you took it. The automatic backup lives in the Firebase console — Point-in-Time Recovery plus a scheduled export. Set both up once; this button is the belt to their braces.
